meta.name: Nürburgring: surrounding ground

elevationSource.title: LVermGeo RLP Digitales Geländemodell DGM1 (1 m, laser scanning)

meta.axes: X east, Y up, Z south (Z = -(northing - origin.northing)); metres
notes: Grid 10 m spacing over the circuit extent plus 300 m (179 x 212); 1742 grid points on or within 3 m of the ribbon removed.
Triangulated together with the lap ribbon's outer shoulder edges as constraints (cdt2d), keeping faces outside the ribbon, so road -> shoulder -> ground is one continuous surface.
Heights: DGM1 1 m tiles, bilinear between cell centres, per grid point (bare earth: no trees or buildings); ribbon edge vertices keep their baked heights.

Fold patch: where a narrowed inner shoulder folds over itself; that edge-loop crossing is cut before triangulating, and a 1 m grid patch (234 triangles) lies under the fold at heights interpolated (inverse distance) from nearby ribbon edge vertices, 0.05 m below them, so no hole remains.

Constrained Delaunay terrain: 76746 triangles sharing the ribbon's outer edge vertices (5111 after cutting 1 shoulder folds); 3 kept faces partly under the ribbon (at a fold; all fully covered faces removed).
